Title: Pahadi Fruit Juices & Squashes
Body (HTML):
Refreshing and medicinal beverages crafted from wild Himalayan fruits and flowers.

Naturally rich in antioxidants and Vitamin C, keeping you energized and healthy. Sourced directly from the clean, high-altitude orchards of Uttarakhand, our squashes bring the authentic taste of the Himalayas right to your home.

Key Highlights:

  • 100% Natural: Made from wild-harvested Himalayan fruits and flowers.
  • Antioxidant Rich: Naturally high in Vitamin C and healing nutrients.
  • Medicinal Benefits: Ideal for boosting immunity, heart health, and energy.

How to Serve:

Mix 1 part squash with 3-4 parts chilled water or soda. Stir well and serve with ice.
